recipes.title: Crispy Microwave Potato Chips
steps: Slice the potato very thinly (a mandoline helps) and soak the slices in a bowl of water for about 10 minutes to rinse off the starch.
Lay the slices on a towel and pat completely dry.
Return to the dry bowl, spray with olive oil, sprinkle with salt and Cajun seasoning and toss well.

Spread in a single layer on a microwave-safe plate lined with parchment. Microwave on high for 3–10 minutes depending on your microwave (about 9 minutes in the video), checking every couple of minutes, until golden and crisp.
recipes.notes: Estimated amounts and macros. Thinner, evenly sliced chips crisp faster; they firm up more as they cool for a minute.
